title: Griefing attack via continuous deposit and withdrawal
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `deposit` function allows users to deposit funds to be added to liquidity pools (LPs) managed by the Rebalancer. When withdrawing tokens, the contract removes the necessary liquidity from the pool to fulfill the withdrawal request. This mechanism can be exploited by an attacker to perform a griefing attack. The attacker can continuously deposit large amounts in each block and withdraw in the next block, thereby forcing the contract to repeatedly remove liquidity from the pool.
